cases.name: mount-registers-command-context
cases.condition: When Canvas mounts, it calls props.registerCommandContext with an accessor for the command context.
cases.outcome: On mount, Canvas registers an accessor that returns the command context.

cases.name: accessor-reads-shared-command-context
cases.condition: When the registered accessor is invoked, it returns the same context shape used by the keydown listener, including the current state, UI, geometry, container rectangle, save callback, inspector-focus callback, and text-edit starter.
cases.outcome: When invoked, the accessor returns the shared context with current state, UI, geometry, container rectangle, save callback, inspector-focus callback, and text-edit starter.
cases.domain: any invocation after mount

cases.name: keydown-reads-shared-command-context
cases.condition: When a keydown event is processed, the listener supplies handleKeyDown with the same shared command-context shape as the registered accessor rather than a separately duplicated literal.
cases.outcome: For each keydown, the listener passes handleKeyDown that same shared command-context shape instead of a duplicate literal.
cases.domain: any keyboard event

cases.name: scene-without-error
cases.condition: When scene.error() is undefined, Canvas does not render an in-canvas error banner.
cases.outcome: When scene.error() is undefined, Canvas renders no in-canvas error banner.

cases.name: scene-with-error
cases.condition: When scene.error() returns an error, Canvas still does not render its former absolutely positioned error banner; error display is left to the StateIsland wiring outside Canvas.
cases.outcome: When scene.error() returns an error, Canvas still renders no former absolutely positioned error banner, leaving display to StateIsland outside Canvas.
cases.domain: any scene error

cases.name: existing-command-registry-preserved
cases.condition: Every pre-existing command entry remains in COMMANDS with its existing label.
cases.outcome: Every pre-existing command remains in COMMANDS with its original label unchanged.
cases.domain: the existing command entries

cases.name: tool-hand-sets-hand-tool
cases.condition: Running tool-hand sets the active tool to hand, matching the neighboring tool commands.
cases.outcome: Running tool-hand sets the active tool to hand.

cases.name: zoom-in-positive-viewport
cases.condition: Running zoom-in with a rectangle whose width and height are both positive calls zoomAboutPoint at the rectangle centre using factor ZOOM_STEP, preserving the point under the centre.
cases.outcome: With a positive-size rectangle, zoom-in zooms by ZOOM_STEP about the rectangle centre while preserving the point beneath it.
cases.domain: rectangles with positive width and height

cases.name: zoom-in-lower-clamp
cases.condition: Running zoom-in would take the zoom below MIN_ZOOM, so zoomAboutPoint clamps the resulting zoom to MIN_ZOOM while remaining anchored at the rectangle centre.
cases.outcome: When zoom-in would fall below MIN_ZOOM, it clamps to MIN_ZOOM while remaining anchored at the rectangle centre.
cases.domain: positive-size rectangles and current zoom values whose zoom-in result is below MIN_ZOOM

cases.name: zoom-in-upper-clamp
cases.condition: Running zoom-in would take the zoom above MAX_ZOOM, so zoomAboutPoint clamps the resulting zoom to MAX_ZOOM while remaining anchored at the rectangle centre.
cases.outcome: When zoom-in would exceed MAX_ZOOM, it clamps to MAX_ZOOM while remaining anchored at the rectangle centre.
cases.domain: positive-size rectangles and current zoom values whose zoom-in result is above MAX_ZOOM

cases.name: zoom-out-positive-viewport
cases.condition: Running zoom-out with a rectangle whose width and height are both positive calls zoomAboutPoint at the rectangle centre using factor 1 / ZOOM_STEP, preserving the point under the centre.
cases.outcome: With a positive-size rectangle, zoom-out zooms by 1 / ZOOM_STEP about the rectangle centre while preserving the point beneath it.
cases.domain: rectangles with positive width and height

cases.name: zoom-out-lower-clamp
cases.condition: Running zoom-out would take the zoom below MIN_ZOOM, so zoomAboutPoint clamps the resulting zoom to MIN_ZOOM while remaining anchored at the rectangle centre.
cases.outcome: When zoom-out would fall below MIN_ZOOM, it clamps to MIN_ZOOM while remaining anchored at the rectangle centre.
cases.domain: positive-size rectangles and current zoom values whose zoom-out result is below MIN_ZOOM

cases.name: zoom-out-upper-clamp
cases.condition: Running zoom-out would take the zoom above MAX_ZOOM, so zoomAboutPoint clamps the resulting zoom to MAX_ZOOM while remaining anchored at the rectangle centre.
cases.outcome: When zoom-out would exceed MAX_ZOOM, it clamps to MAX_ZOOM while remaining anchored at the rectangle centre.
cases.domain: positive-size rectangles and current zoom values whose zoom-out result is above MAX_ZOOM

cases.name: zoom-reset-centred-to-one
cases.condition: Running zoom-reset with a positive-size rectangle uses the factor that takes the current zoom exactly to 1 and rewrites panX and panY through zoomAboutPoint so the point under the rectangle centre stays fixed; it does not reset pan to the origin.
cases.outcome: With a positive-size rectangle, zoom-reset uses the factor needed to reach zoom 1 and rewrites pan through the centre-anchored zoom so the centre point stays fixed rather than resetting pan to the origin.
cases.domain: positive-size rectangles and current zoom values

cases.name: zoom-fit-valid-geometry
cases.condition: Running zoom-fit with a positive-size rectangle and defined geometry whose index is non-empty calls fitBoundsToRect with geometry.contentBounds, the rectangle, and FIT_PADDING.
cases.outcome: With a positive-size rectangle and non-empty defined geometry, zoom-fit calls fitBoundsToRect with geometry.contentBounds, the rectangle, and FIT_PADDING.
cases.domain: positive-size rectangles and geometries with at least one index entry

cases.name: zoom-fit-content-bounds-source
cases.condition: Running zoom-fit uses SceneGeometry.contentBounds as published and does not recompute a union from index bounds.
cases.outcome: zoom-fit uses the published SceneGeometry.contentBounds without recomputing bounds from the index.
cases.domain: non-empty geometries whose published contentBounds may differ from a separately recomputed union

cases.name: zero-width-or-height-viewport-no-op
cases.condition: Each of zoom-in, zoom-out, zoom-reset, and zoom-fit does nothing when context.rect has zero width or zero height.
cases.outcome: Each zoom command does nothing when the rectangle has zero width or zero height.
cases.domain: rectangles with width 0 or height 0

cases.name: zoom-fit-undefined-geometry-no-op
cases.condition: Running zoom-fit does nothing when geometry is undefined, provided the rectangle has positive width and height.
cases.outcome: zoom-fit does nothing when geometry is undefined and the rectangle has positive dimensions.

cases.name: zoom-fit-empty-index-no-op
cases.condition: Running zoom-fit does nothing when geometry is defined but geometry.index.length is 0, provided the rectangle has positive width and height.
cases.outcome: zoom-fit does nothing when defined geometry has an empty index and the rectangle has positive dimensions.

cases.name: declared-fit-padding
cases.condition: FIT_PADDING has its declared value of 40 CSS pixels of the viewport, used as the screen-space margin around content during zoom-fit.
cases.outcome: uses a 40 CSS-pixel viewport margin around content during zoom-fit.

cases.name: declared-zoom-step
cases.condition: The constant has the declared numeric value 1.2 and serves as the multiplicative factor for one zoom-in press.
cases.outcome: Defines ZOOM_STEP as the numeric multiplier 1.2 for one zoom-in press.

cases.name: no-document-no-autoload
cases.condition: The URL has none of the auto-load parameters, so no document is loaded initially and StartScreen is shown instead of IslandFrame.
cases.outcome: With no auto-load parameters, it leaves the document unloaded and shows StartScreen instead of IslandFrame.

cases.name: autoload-parameter-present
cases.condition: The URL contains at least one auto-load parameter, causing the adapter load to start on mount.
cases.outcome: With an auto-load parameter, it starts the adapter load on mount and shows StartScreen while loading.
cases.domain: one or more of: d, s, fetch, gh, pr, issue

cases.name: autoload-success-with-stylesheet
cases.condition: The automatic adapter load succeeds and returns both a diagram and a stylesheet; the editor session is installed using the loaded stylesheet after component bindings are seeded.
cases.outcome: On successful load with a stylesheet, it seeds component bindings into that stylesheet and installs the editor session.

cases.name: autoload-success-without-stylesheet
cases.condition: The automatic adapter load succeeds with no stylesheet; a new empty stylesheet is created, component bindings are seeded into it, and the editor session starts.
cases.outcome: On successful load without a stylesheet, it creates an empty stylesheet, seeds component bindings into it, and starts the editor session.

cases.name: load-failure
cases.condition: The adapter load returns an error; loading is cleared, the error is exposed to StartScreen, and no document frame is installed.
cases.outcome: On load failure, it clears loading, exposes the adapter error on StartScreen, and does not install a document frame.

cases.name: loading-in-progress
cases.condition: An auto-load request is pending; loading is true and StartScreen receives the loading state.
cases.outcome: While an auto-load request is pending, it sets loading true and passes that state to StartScreen.

cases.name: manual-open-success
cases.condition: From the no-document StartScreen, opening a file succeeds and installs the editor session with its diagram, stylesheet, save controller, and file synchronization.
cases.outcome: On successful manual open, it installs the diagram session, save controller, and file synchronization.

cases.name: manual-open-failure
cases.condition: A manually requested adapter load fails; the failure is surfaced through the StartScreen error state rather than logged only to the console.
cases.outcome: On manual-open failure, it clears loading and surfaces the adapter error through StartScreen instead of only logging it.

cases.name: island-frame-after-load
cases.condition: A document is loaded, so StartScreen is replaced by IslandFrame with the Canvas in the canvas slot and all six islands rendered in their slots.
cases.outcome: After loading a document, it replaces StartScreen with IslandFrame containing the full-bleed Canvas and all six islands.

cases.name: command-context-unset
cases.condition: An island invokes onCommand before Canvas has registered its command context; the invocation is a no-op while the islands remain rendered.
cases.outcome: Before Canvas registers its context, an island command is a no-op while all islands remain rendered.

cases.name: command-context-set
cases.condition: Canvas has registered its command context; an island command invokes runCommand against that exact Canvas-provided context.
cases.outcome: After Canvas registers its context, an island command calls runCommand with that exact Canvas-provided context.

cases.name: select-tool-active
cases.condition: The active tool is select; StateIsland receives an undefined mode.
cases.outcome: When the select tool is active, StateIsland receives an undefined mode.

cases.name: non-select-tool-active
cases.condition: The active tool is not select; StateIsland receives that registered tool's Command.label as its mode.
cases.outcome: When another tool is active, StateIsland receives that tool's registered Command.label as its mode.
cases.domain: any registered active tool other than select

cases.name: scene-error-present
cases.condition: The scene exposes an error that has not been dismissed; StateIsland receives that error.
cases.outcome: When scene.error() is an undismissed error, StateIsland receives that error.
cases.domain: any scene error

cases.name: scene-error-dismissed
cases.condition: The current scene error is the error recorded by dismissedError; StateIsland does not receive it after dismissal.
cases.outcome: When the current scene error matches dismissedError, StateIsland receives no error.

cases.name: different-scene-error-after-dismissal
cases.condition: scene.error() changes to a different error after a dismissal; dismissedError is reset so the new error is exposed to StateIsland.
cases.outcome: When scene.error() changes after dismissal, it resets dismissedError so the new error is exposed to StateIsland.

cases.name: file-name-query-present
cases.condition: The URL contains a file or name query value, so FileIsland receives that value as fileName.
cases.outcome: When ?file= or ?name= supplies a value, FileIsland receives that query value as fileName.
cases.domain: any value supplied by ?file= or ?name=

cases.name: file-name-query-absent
cases.condition: Neither ?file= nor ?name= supplies a file name, so FileIsland receives the fallback name Untitled.
cases.outcome: When neither file nor name supplies a value, FileIsland receives Untitled as fileName.

cases.name: valid-stored-editor-theme
cases.condition: localStorage contains a recognized archeglyph.editorTheme value; that editor theme is selected, applied to the document root, and persisted.
cases.outcome: When storage contains a recognized editor theme, it selects, applies, and persists that theme.
cases.domain: any recognized editor theme name

cases.name: unknown-stored-editor-theme
cases.condition: localStorage contains a theme name that is not available; the configured default editor theme is selected instead.
cases.outcome: When storage contains an unavailable theme, it falls back to the configured default editor theme.
cases.domain: any unavailable theme name

cases.name: editor-theme-storage-unavailable
cases.condition: Reading or writing localStorage throws, such as in a private or restricted window; the editor continues using the default or selected theme without storage persistence.
cases.outcome: When storage access throws, it continues with the default or selected theme without persistence.

cases.name: inspector-geometry-available
cases.condition: A loaded scene has geometry; Inspector is rendered with the existing state, UI, theme, geometry, and focus-registration props.
cases.outcome: When scene geometry is available, it renders Inspector with the existing state, UI, theme, geometry, and focus-registration props.

cases.name: inspector-geometry-unavailable
cases.condition: A loaded scene has no geometry yet; Inspector is not rendered until geometry becomes available.
cases.outcome: When scene geometry is unavailable, it does not render Inspector until geometry becomes available.

cases.name: file-name-rendered
cases.condition: A file name is provided; the component renders the file name first in the island.
cases.outcome: Renders the provided file name first in the island.
cases.domain: any file-name string

cases.name: idle-status
cases.condition: Status is idle; no status text is rendered.
cases.outcome: Renders no status text when the status is idle.

cases.name: saving-status
cases.condition: Status is saving; the status text is rendered as "Saving...".
cases.outcome: Renders the status text "Saving..." when saving.

cases.name: saved-status
cases.condition: Status is saved; the status text is rendered as "Saved".
cases.outcome: Renders the status text "Saved" when saved.

cases.name: unsaved-status
cases.condition: Status is unsaved; the status text is rendered as "Unsaved".
cases.outcome: Renders the status text "Unsaved" when unsaved.

cases.name: error-status
cases.condition: Status is error; the status text is rendered as "Save failed", using --ag-danger, and the error indicator replaces the dirty dot.
cases.outcome: Renders "Save failed" in --ag-danger and replaces the dirty dot with the error indicator.

cases.name: clean-document
cases.condition: The document is not dirty; the --ag-teal dirty dot is not shown.
cases.outcome: Does not show the --ag-teal dirty dot when the document is clean.

cases.name: dirty-document
cases.condition: The document is dirty and status is not error; the --ag-teal dirty dot is shown.
cases.outcome: Shows the --ag-teal dirty dot when the document is dirty and the status is not error.
cases.domain: any non-error status

cases.name: dirty-saving-or-saved
cases.condition: The document is dirty while status is saving or saved; the status text remains "Saving..." or "Saved" respectively, and the --ag-teal dirty dot remains visible.
cases.outcome: Keeps the --ag-teal dirty dot visible and renders "Saving..." or "Saved" for dirty documents in those statuses.
cases.domain: one of: saving, saved

cases.name: save-available
cases.condition: canSave is true; the Save button is rendered and can provide the real click needed to initiate the first file write.
cases.outcome: Renders a Save button that provides the real click needed to initiate the first file write.

cases.name: save-unavailable
cases.condition: canSave is false; the Save button is not rendered.
cases.outcome: Does not render the Save button when canSave is false.

cases.name: theme-picker-options
cases.condition: The palette picker is rendered with EDITOR_THEMES as its options, displayed by theme label.
cases.outcome: Renders the palette picker with EDITOR_THEMES as options displayed by theme label.
cases.domain: any EDITOR_THEMES collection

cases.name: theme-selection-change
cases.condition: The user changes the palette selection; the browser chrome preference changes without marking the document dirty and without writing to the diagram or style file.
cases.outcome: Changes the browser chrome palette preference without marking the document dirty or writing to the diagram or style file.
cases.domain: any selectable EDITOR_THEMES label

cases.name: declared-inset-value
cases.condition: The constant has its declared value of 12 CSS pixels, representing the gap between an island and the viewport edge.
cases.outcome: The constant should equal 12 CSS pixels, defining the gap between an island and the viewport edge.

cases.name: loaded-document-with-canvas
cases.condition: A document is loaded, so IslandFrame is mounted and its canvas slot contains the real Canvas rather than StartScreen.
cases.outcome: Mounts IslandFrame with the real Canvas in the canvas slot.

cases.name: document-not-loaded
cases.condition: No document exists, including a load failure before a document is created; IslandFrame is not mounted and StartScreen owns the surface.
cases.outcome: Does not mount IslandFrame, leaving StartScreen to own the surface.

cases.name: present-slot-placement
cases.condition: Any supplied slot is rendered in its D13 position: toolbar top-centre, inspector top-left, file top-right, zoom bottom-left, undo bottom-right, or state bottom-centre.
cases.outcome: Renders each supplied slot in its declared D13 position.
cases.domain: one of: toolbar, inspector, file, zoom, undo, state

cases.name: optional-slots-omitted
cases.condition: Any subset of the island slots is absent; only present islands receive positioned wrappers, with no placeholder or status bar rendered for omitted slots.
cases.outcome: Renders only supplied islands, with no placeholders or status bar for omitted slots.
cases.domain: any subset of the six island slots

cases.name: all-slots-present
cases.condition: All six island slots are supplied while a document is loaded; each is overlaid on the full-bleed canvas at its declared position.
cases.outcome: Overlays all six supplied islands on the full-bleed canvas at their declared positions.

cases.name: pointer-events-on-island-only
cases.condition: A pointer targets an island or empty canvas beneath a slot wrapper: the wrapper remains pointer-events:none and positioning-only, while the island root with ag-island receives pointer events and empty canvas remains available for pans and marquees.
cases.outcome: Keeps wrappers pointer-events:none while allowing only ag-island roots to receive pointer events, leaving empty canvas interactive.
cases.domain: an island target or empty canvas target

cases.name: content-sized-island
cases.condition: A present island has content that does not exceed its slot budget; its wrapper has no definite height, so height:100% content resolves to auto and the island remains content-sized.
cases.outcome: Leaves the wrapper height indefinite so height:100% resolves to auto and the island remains content-sized.
cases.domain: content fitting within the slot's max-height

cases.name: tall-top-island
cases.condition: A top-anchored island exceeds its available vertical budget; it is limited to half the viewport height less twice ISLAND_INSET and its own root scrolls instead of colliding with the opposite island.
cases.outcome: Limits the top island to half the viewport less twice ISLAND_INSET and lets its own root scroll.
cases.domain: top-anchored content taller than its budget

cases.name: tall-bottom-island
cases.condition: A bottom-anchored island exceeds its available vertical budget; it is limited to half the viewport height less twice ISLAND_INSET and its own root scrolls instead of colliding with the opposite island.
cases.outcome: Limits the bottom island to half the viewport less twice ISLAND_INSET and lets its own root scroll.
cases.domain: bottom-anchored content taller than its budget

cases.name: island-inset
cases.condition: Present islands are inset from the corresponding viewport edges by ISLAND_INSET rather than positioned flush against an edge.
cases.outcome: Offsets each present island from its corresponding viewport edges by ISLAND_INSET.
cases.domain: any present island

cases.name: non-form-mousedown
cases.condition: A mousedown occurs on an island element that is not a genuine form control; default focus-on-click is prevented so the ancestor keyboard handler retains focus behavior.
cases.outcome: Prevents the mousedown default on non-form island elements so ancestor keyboard handling retains focus.
cases.domain: a non-form island element

cases.name: form-control-mousedown
cases.condition: A mousedown occurs on a genuine form control, specifically the file island theme select; default handling is not suppressed so the control can receive focus and operate.
cases.outcome: Allows the theme select's mousedown default so the genuine form control can receive focus and operate.

cases.name: scene-error-after-document
cases.condition: A scene error occurs after a document exists; the error is surfaced on StateIsland while the frame remains the document shell.
cases.outcome: Keeps the document frame mounted and surfaces the scene error on StateIsland.

cases.name: failed-save
cases.condition: A save fails; the failure is surfaced on FileIsland and may coexist with a scene error on StateIsland.
cases.outcome: Surfaces the save failure on FileIsland, independently of any scene error.

cases.name: scene-error-and-save-error
cases.condition: A scene error and a failed save occur together after a document exists; both distinct errors are shown on their respective islands.
cases.outcome: Shows the scene error on StateIsland and the save error on FileIsland simultaneously.

cases.name: no-error
cases.condition: The start screen is rendered when there is no file-opening error; it shows the wordmark and the 'Open file...' action.
cases.outcome: Renders the wordmark and an 'Open file...' action, with no error message.

cases.name: file-opening-error
cases.condition: The start screen is rendered when a file-opening error is present; it shows the wordmark, the 'Open file...' action, and the error.
cases.outcome: Renders the wordmark and an 'Open file...' action followed by the file-opening error.
cases.domain: any file-opening error

cases.name: error-with-dismiss
cases.condition: An error is present and onDismiss is supplied; the island shows the full wrapping error text with error styling and renders the dismiss control.
cases.outcome: It shows the full wrapping error text with error styling and renders the supplied dismiss control.
cases.domain: any error string with any supplied dismiss callback

cases.name: error-without-dismiss
cases.condition: An error is present and onDismiss is not supplied; the island shows the full wrapping error text with error styling and does not render a dismiss control.
cases.outcome: It shows the full wrapping error text with error styling and omits the dismiss control.
cases.domain: any error string

cases.name: error-over-mode
cases.condition: Both an error and a mode are set; the error state wins, so the mode label is suppressed and the island remains a single error row. The dismiss control follows whether onDismiss is supplied.
cases.outcome: It prioritizes the error, suppresses the mode label, keeps a single error row, and renders the dismiss control only if onDismiss is supplied.
cases.domain: any error string, any mode label, and either presence or absence of onDismiss

cases.name: mode-only
cases.condition: A mode is set without an error; the island uses ordinary panel styling and shows the mode label in the secondary foreground color.
cases.outcome: It uses ordinary panel styling and displays the mode label in the secondary foreground color.
cases.domain: any mode label

cases.name: select-tool-active
cases.condition: The select tool is the active tool; it is the only tool button receiving the active blue styling, while hand and annotation remain inactive.
cases.outcome: Marks only the select button with --ag-blue and --ag-blue-soft, leaving hand and annotation inactive.

cases.name: hand-tool-active
cases.condition: The hand tool is the active tool; it is the only tool button receiving the active blue styling, while select and annotation remain inactive.
cases.outcome: Marks only the hand button with --ag-blue and --ag-blue-soft, leaving select and annotation inactive.

cases.name: annotation-tool-active
cases.condition: The annotation tool is the active tool; it is the only tool button receiving the active blue styling, while select and hand remain inactive.
cases.outcome: Marks only the annotation button with --ag-blue and --ag-blue-soft, leaving select and hand inactive.

cases.name: registry-labels-and-chords
cases.condition: Toolbar buttons use the labels from the command registry and, when present, the corresponding keymap chords to assemble their text and tooltips; no button text or hint is hardcoded in the toolbar.
cases.outcome: Builds each button's text and tooltip from its registry label and optional keymap chord without hardcoded text or hints.
cases.domain: any registered toolbar command with a label and optional keymap chord

cases.name: command-without-chord
cases.condition: A toolbar command has no keymap chord, so its assembled button text and tooltip contain the registry label alone rather than a label followed by a parenthesized key.
cases.outcome: Uses the registry label alone for the command's button text and tooltip when no chord is mapped.
cases.domain: any registered toolbar command lacking a chord

cases.name: command-with-chord
cases.condition: A toolbar command has a keymap chord, so its assembled button text and tooltip contain the registry label followed by the chord in parentheses.
cases.outcome: Uses the registry label followed by the mapped chord in parentheses for the command's button text and tooltip.
cases.domain: any registered toolbar command with a chord

cases.name: both-history-actions-available
cases.condition: Undo and redo history actions are available; both icon buttons are rendered enabled and the island retains its fixed two-button width.
cases.outcome: Render both undo and redo icon buttons enabled while preserving the island's fixed two-button width.
cases.domain: one of the editor history states where both undo and redo are available

cases.name: undo-unavailable
cases.condition: Undo is unavailable while redo may be available; the undo button remains rendered but is disabled rather than hidden.
cases.outcome: Keep the undo button rendered but disabled when undo is unavailable.
cases.domain: any history state with no undoable action

cases.name: redo-unavailable
cases.condition: Redo is unavailable while undo may be available; the redo button remains rendered but is disabled rather than hidden.
cases.outcome: Keep the redo button rendered but disabled when redo is unavailable.
cases.domain: any history state with no redoable action

cases.name: both-history-actions-unavailable
cases.condition: Neither undo nor redo is available; both buttons remain rendered and disabled, preserving the island width.
cases.outcome: Render both buttons disabled so the island retains its fixed width.
cases.domain: any history state with neither an undoable nor redoable action

cases.name: command-label-from-registry
cases.condition: A history command has a registry Command.label; that label supplies the button text and tooltip label.
cases.outcome: Use the registry Command.label for the history button text and tooltip label.
cases.domain: any registered undo or redo command label

cases.name: command-with-key-chord
cases.condition: A history command has a keymap chord; its tooltip combines the registry label and chord as `<label> (<key>)`, while the keymap supplies only the chord.
cases.outcome: Build the tooltip as the registry label followed by the keymap chord in parentheses.
cases.domain: any command with a configured keymap chord

cases.name: command-without-key-chord
cases.condition: A history command has no keymap chord; its tooltip contains the registry label alone.
cases.outcome: Use only the registry label as the tooltip when no keymap chord exists.
cases.domain: any command without a configured keymap chord

cases.name: mousedown-on-focused-button
cases.condition: A mousedown occurs on a focused undo or redo button; the default is prevented so keyboard activation keys such as Space and Enter are not swallowed by the button.
cases.outcome: Prevent the mousedown default on focused undo and redo buttons so Space and Enter remain available for keyboard activation.
cases.domain: any mousedown event targeting either button

cases.name: history-changes-during-edit-run
cases.condition: History availability changes as edits are made or undone/redone; unavailable buttons are disabled rather than removed, so the island does not change width or walk across the corner.
cases.outcome: Keep unavailable buttons rendered and disabled as history changes so the island neither changes width nor walks across the corner.
cases.domain: any sequence of editor history changes

cases.name: render-with-current-zoom
cases.condition: The component renders the zoom controls for the supplied current zoom value: minus, percentage readout, plus, and a separated Fit control.
cases.outcome: Renders an ag-island with minus, the current percentage readout, plus, and a separated Fit control.
cases.domain: any supplied zoom value

cases.name: rounded-percentage-readout
cases.condition: The readout displays Math.round(zoom * 100) followed by a percent sign, so fractional zoom values are rounded to the nearest displayed percentage.
cases.outcome: Displays Math.round(zoom * 100) followed by a percent sign.
cases.domain: any numeric zoom value, including fractional values

cases.name: pinch-crosses-digit-width
cases.condition: The zoom changes across values such as 90%, 100%, and 110%; the fixed 4ch monospace readout width keeps the plus control from shifting horizontally.
cases.outcome: Keeps the monospace readout at a fixed 4ch width so the plus control does not shift as the percentage gains digits.
cases.domain: zoom values whose rounded percentages change digit count

cases.name: readout-activation
cases.condition: The readout button is clicked or keyboard-activated, invoking the zoom-reset action.
cases.outcome: Clicking or keyboard-activating the readout invokes the zoom-reset action.
cases.domain: pointer or keyboard activation of the readout

cases.name: minus-activation
cases.condition: The minus control is activated to request zooming out.
cases.outcome: Activating the minus control requests zooming out.
cases.domain: pointer or keyboard activation of the minus control

cases.name: plus-activation
cases.condition: The plus control is activated to request zooming in.
cases.outcome: Activating the plus control requests zooming in.
cases.domain: pointer or keyboard activation of the plus control

cases.name: fit-activation
cases.condition: The separated Fit control is activated to request fitting the view, using the purple secondary-control styling.
cases.outcome: Activating the separated Fit control requests fitting the view and uses the purple secondary-control styling.
